name: Email body ~16MB observes behavior at size boundary
description: Verifies behavior when an email with a body of approximately 16MB (16,777,216 bytes) is sent. Records whether a Case is created or the email is rejected, and reports the observed outcome. This test may succeed or fail depending on Salesforce limits.

verification.description: Record whether a Case is created or the email is rejected at the 16MB body size. Report observed outcome.

assertions.value: Case created or not at 16MB body size
LostEmail record presence at 16MB body size
